articles.title: Fixing Hallucinations Would Destroy ChatGPT, Expert Finds
articles.summary: In a paper published earlier this month, OpenAI researchers said they had found the reason why even the most powerful AI models are suffering from rampant "hallucinations." They found that the way we evaluate the output of large language models, like the ones driving ChatGPT, means they're "optimized to be good test-takers" and that "guessing when uncertain improves test performance." In simple terms, we incentivized them to guess rather than admit they don't know the answer, a dangerous quality, given the degree of confidence with which AIs utter these falsehoods.
